items.title: IBM may be caught up in latest bout of AI volatility: 'Don't concentrate in any one theme'
items.summary: IBM (IBM) lowered its full-year sales out after falling short of second quarter earnings and revenue estimates. The stock is down nearly 30% year-to-date in 2026. Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management Company CIO Brent Schutte joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on Opening Bid to discuss the latest round of AI volatility that the chipmaker may be caught up in.
